_comment: Hosts and ids the forbidden-string gate lets through, each with the reason. Add nothing here without a reason.

hosts.reason: The public name of the family lab-proxy (https://local.ping-devops.com:8443/hostile-a2a/). The Origin check compares the browser's Origin with it, so the code and its tests must name it.
The Host the family lab-proxy sends for this app: the docker-compose LAB_ALLOWED_HOSTS default, the README and the same-origin tests name it.
